description: The source describes an implemented cyber-physical electrical-power laboratory with a scaled CIGRE medium-voltage system, converter controls and five ancillary services. Its configuration extends conventional power-hardware-in-the-loop testing and supports controlled integration of physical electrical and communication components. The platform is a documented research testbed, with public remote access, reproducible installation, code and operating costs unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
